# glfx.js

Unmodified browser distribution by Evan Wallace, distributed under the MIT license in `LICENSE`.

- Project: https://github.com/evanw/glfx.js
- API documentation: https://evanw.github.io/glfx.js/docs/
- Distribution: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/evanw/glfx.js/1bf5f4ec7dfbd039da81d254fb1874cbb0e88228/glfx.js
- License: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/evanw/glfx.js/86ae72acfffcd50774507eb7b69887ba2493dc35/LICENSE
- SHA-256 of `glfx.js`: `14332D2B292A59E07D2CD3F86BF7E3BAA4774A39FCC6AB36C0CBA41532657AC3`

Served locally and loaded only when the user enables enhancements. No CDN or build-time package restore is required. The viewer uses brightness/contrast, curves (gamma), denoise, hue/saturation, vibrance and unsharp-mask filters. Camera credentials, playback, recordings and zoom remain outside this library.
